zh.title: 神鷹航空擬2027年夏季開通英國三城航線
zh.summary: 神鷹航空擬於2027年夏季加入布里斯托、格拉斯哥與因弗內斯航線
body: 據《Aerospace Global News》報導，漢莎航空集團旗下的休閒航空公司 Discover Airlines（中文名待確認）計畫自2027年5月起，開通從布里斯托至法蘭克福的航線，每週兩班。
同時，法蘭克福至格拉斯哥的航線每週將服務六班，而從慕尼黑至格拉斯哥則提供夏季每週兩班的航班。
另外，法蘭克福至因弗內斯的航線計畫自2027年6月19日至9月11日，每週六執飛一班。
該公司指出，這些航線預計由A320機型執行飛行，飛行時間約為兩小時。

en.title: Discover Airlines plans to connect Bristol, Glasgow and Inverness from Frankfurt from 2027
en.summary: Discover Airlines is planning to start flights to Bristol, Glasgow and Inverness from Frankfurt and Munich in summer 2027.
body: German leisure carrier Discover Airlines, part of the Lufthansa Group, plans to start serving three UK regional airports from summer 2027, following reports in Aerospace Global News.
According to the report, from May 2027, the airline expects to operate flights from Bristol to Frankfurt twice a week, on Mondays and Thursdays.
Flights between Frankfurt and Glasgow are planned for six times a week, with a twice-weekly summer connection to Munich.
The new route to Inverness will initially operate once a week on Saturdays from 19 June to 11 September 2027, linking the Scottish Highlands with Frankfurt.
The airline expects these routes to be served by A320 aircraft, with a flight time of about two hours.

facts.claim: Discover Airlines plans to start flights from Bristol and Glasgow from May 2027.
facts.sourceQuote: From May 2027, flights will be operated from Bristol to Frankfurt twice a week, on Mondays and Thursdays. Flights between Frankfurt and Glasgow will be served six times a week

facts.claim: Discover Airlines plans to serve Inverness from Frankfurt once a week on Saturdays from 19 June to 11 September 2027.
facts.sourceQuote: the new route to Inverness will initially operate once a week on Saturdays from 19 June to 11 September 2027

facts.claim: The new links from Frankfurt to Glasgow, Bristol and Inverness and from Munich to Glasgow are expected to be served by A320 aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: The new links from Frankfurt to Glasgow, Bristol and Inverness and from Munich to Glasgow are expected to be served by A320s

facts.claim: A Munich-Glasgow route is a route previously flown by Lufthansa itself.
facts.sourceQuote: the Munich-Glasgow route is not a new route for the Group; it is taking over a route previously flown by Lufthansa itself.
